items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Well, there was his brother on trumpet, James Tate. Bob S Hoffner on trumpet, and first part was John Thomas on trombone.

ctx.x: Yeah. Who was in that Tate band, do you remember?
Well, there was his brother on trumpet, James Tate. Bob S Hoffner on trumpet, and first part was John Thomas on trombone. Then later on we got Louis Taylor
